_verdict.conclusion: Bias-limited. Best capacity configuration reaches 69.84% (d128_l4), 5.4 points below the LogReg reference of 75.26%, and 11 of 12 cells fall in a 65.5-69.8% band, so capacity is not the binding constraint. The learning curve is still rising but flattens: +2.51, +1.77, +1.46 acc-points per 239 samples, an instantaneous slope of 0.43 acc-points per 100 samples at n=958. A log fit (acc = 39.6 + 4.10*ln n) projects 5,939 samples -- 6.2x the current training set -- just to reach LogReg parity, and 11,579 for 78%. No available cohort supplies that. The honest conclusion is that this architecture has a poorer inductive bias than a linear model on this 713-dimension, n=958 problem, so more aggressive regularization or pretraining is unlikely to close a 5-point gap.
